::: {.letter-metadata}
**Date:** Feb 28th 1896  
**From:** Elderfield Otterbourne  
**Manuscript:** MS British Library  Add MSS 54921: 223
:::

Dear [Mr Macmillan](people/person_942.qmd)
I am very glad of your favourable answer about the [Cameos](cmy_books/cmybook_240.qmd). I shall be glad of the terms you propose - dividing the profits and you taking the risk, my object being to have them continued without expense

I am delighted to see the faithful and affectionate notice in the new number of the Magazine[^1] 

Yours truly
C M Yonge

---

[^1]: The obituary of Alexander Macmillan, sr., who had died on 26 January 1896: ‘Alexander Macmillan’ *Macmillan’s Magazine*  73 (March 1896) 397-400.
